g.text: Pippin, a villain name, plays the bad role; Max, a kind name, the good role

g.text: Gray italic: prewritten text, reused across stories

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: Black: text generated for this specific story

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: Pippin and Max were together by the fence. The neighbor sat nearby.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Opening

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: Pippin and Max played a counting game. The rule was to close your eyes and count to ten. It was Pippin's turn, and Max looked away.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Cheat scene

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: Pippin only counted to five and then shouted, "I win!"

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #c62828

g.text: Bad ending

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: A moment later, Pippin heard a dog barking somewhere far away. Then it was quiet again, and Pippin went on.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: Max walked to the pond. Max had some bread. Max fed the ducks.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Extra scene

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: Pippin stacked the crackers into a tower, and it leaned to one side. Max sat right next to it.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Tease scene

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: "It is a very tall tower," said Max.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f5fae

g.text: Benign ending

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: Just then, a yellow leaf floated down and landed near Max's shoe. Max watched it wobble in the wind.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: Max put Max's bread down and went to ask the neighbor for a drink. Pippin sat right next to the bread.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Steal scene

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: Pippin took Max's bread and hid it under Pippin's shirt.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #c62828

g.text: Bad ending

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: After that, Pippin looked up at the clouds for a while. The clouds drifted slowly across the big blue sky.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: Pippin went to the water. Pippin jumped into the pool to swim.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Extra scene

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: Pippin set Pippin's toy truck down and bent to tie a shoe. Max was right beside the truck.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Steal scene

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: Max picked up Pippin's toy truck and handed it to Pippin.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #1f5fae

g.text: Benign ending

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: Max noticed an ant carrying a crumb across the step. It went one way, then the other, and then it was gone.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #333333

g.text: The neighbor looked at Max. "Do not break other people's things," the neighbor said.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Admonishment

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #7a7973

g.text: Soon it was time for dinner, and the day was done.

text.style: font-size: 5.882353px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #898781

g.text: Closing
